patch.role: Comma leg: rewrites the comma run of non-identifier characters.
Exclamation leg: rewrites the '!' run of non-identifier characters.

inputs.mask_two_runs: identifier with exactly two runs of non-identifier characters
inputs.expose_three_runs: identifier with three runs: the bounded rewrite leaves one behind

rationale: A rewrites every run of non-identifier characters to a single hyphen. The patch covers exactly the comma and '!' runs (one leg each), so an identifier containing only those two runs is fully masked, while an identifier with a third run keeps it raw and is the exposing witness.
